relationships.subject: cannabidiolic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: the acidic forms of phytocannabinoids, such as CBDA and cannabigerolic acid (CBGA), downregulate cyclooxygenase (COX) 1 and 2

relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: CBD has the potential to specifically inhibit FAAH, which delays the degradation of the anti-inflammatory endocannabinoid anandamide

relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: CBD and CBDA have an affinity for this receptor, inhibiting the transcription and translation of inflammatory genes

key_findings: Review of cannabinoids in cats: CBD/CBDA pharmacokinetics vary by formulation; CB2 and PPAR expression are upregulated in feline inflammatory disease.
